$description: Design tokens of the 2026-10 redesign (see the FFT app (current) canvas). Light theme by default, dark theme available; the workout in progress has its own theme setting. All values in px (= pt on iOS, dp on Android). Dark values live in src/design/tokens.ts (palettes.dark).

domain.note: Colour code (DECISIONS 107): one colour per area. Macros: protein pink, carbs yellow, fat sky blue. Everything else: text colour on surfaceAlt.

areaHues.note: DECISIONS 118: the colours Supporter and Premium can give training, nutrition and streak (light main; soft, ink and dark values in tokens.ts areaFamilies). Never green or red; nutrition never pink; two areas never share one.

accentRules: Only ONE accent-filled element per screen: the primary action (Start, Save…, Add to…, Done set).
Never use accent for body text.
The 'white' accent is 'Mono': near-black on light, near-white on dark.

rules: One family everywhere. Big numbers semibold with tabular digits; page titles bold.
Minimum text size 12px anywhere. Text inputs 16px.
Sentence case everywhere; no uppercase labels.

safeArea.note: Use react-native-safe-area-context insets; the numbers are the iPhone 15 values used in the mockups.

components.Gauge: Progress arc (calories, 270°) or ring (macros, rest timer) with the number in the middle.
components.DotBar: A rounded bar filled from the left (macros, water); 'segment' shape for steps (session progress).
components.DotColumnChart: Rounded columns, one per data point.
components.Card: surface, 1px borderDecorative, radius 20, no shadow. Selected: 2px borderSelected.
components.Chip: 44px high pill on the card colour. Selected = 2px borderSelected.
components.Segmented: Grey track, the selected option is a raised white pill.
components.Toggle: 50×30. On = text-colour track; off = control-border track; white knob.
components.Toast: Dark (text colour) pill with light text and UNDO, pinned above the bottom bar, 5 s.
